title: Forza Horizon 5
notes: Steam copy (build 21856128), ~1 hour of testing across both engines. Gets past startup, Xbox sign-in and into free roam / the benchmark, but isn't playable: 1. All scenery (trees, poles, buildings) renders tilted. Only the car and road look right. Same on D3DMetal 3 (r21) and D3DMetal 4 (r20), with the Intel Arc or the NVIDIA RTX 3060 spoof, and on the Low preset. 2. "Fatal Error" 0x800705aa (ERROR_NO_SYSTEM_RESOURCES) after 37 s to 6 min of driving. VRAM in use was only ~200 MB to 1.5 GB. Before one crash: RtlpWaitForCriticalSection ... wait timed out (60 sec). Same on r20 and r21. What it needed to get that far: - A GPU spoof. With no spoof (default AMD), it crashes at startup in graphics init (read of 0x10 at ForzaHorizon5.exe+0x667BA5). - Xbox sign-in: XAL's WebView2 window (fixed runtime 91.0.864.67 in ForzaHorizon5\webview2) is black under D3DMetal, like Steam's own window. Workaround: a stand-in msedgewebview2.exe that drops the d3dmetal dirs from WINEDLLPATH_PREPEND and adds --remote-debugging-port=9222 (the real exe moved to webview2\rt\, because Chromium CHECK-fails if renamed). Then I drove the page from a Mac browser (brave://inspect). Microsoft passkeys (Windows Hello) can't work under Wine, so I signed in with a password. Also tried: DXMT crashes at DXGI (Unknown interface query f0db4c7f-fe5a-42a2-bd62-f2a6cf6fc83e). CrossOver 26.2 crashes at startup (probably needs GetIntegratedDisplaySize, your patch 0017).
issues: All scenery renders tilted (only car/road correct) and Fatal Error 0x800705aa within 37 s – 6 min of driving, on D3DMetal 3 and 4
